[Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/the_democratic_republic_of_the_congo_medium_term_projection__fewsnet_ipc_shapefile_for_2019]
datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule throughout 2019 for the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The classifications were spatially mapped to administrative or livelihood zones and stored in geographic formats (GeoJSON, KML) with metadata including classification scale, scenario type, and collection dates.
